parts:
[I hijacked this thread from stan-users.]

There's a whole range of functionality surrounding diff eqs,
integrals, and optimization we'd like to add to Stan.

The first step for me is laying out what each of these would
look like in the language from a user's point of view. Let's
talk about this at an upcoming Stan meeting --- I'd like to
understand where these things would be used. They may also play
into a lot of what we're trying to do with VB, EP, MML, and related
optimization/approximation techniques.

The second step is understanding how to implement it.

Then the third step is getting it funded/finding time to do it.

What we need to do to get it funded is either (a) find a grant
dedicated to developing computational infrastructure (we have one and
just got another), or (b) find an application area that needs the
functionality and get the application and research into fitting the models
funded. I'd like to roll a lot of this into an NIH grant that may target
both (a) and (b) together with PK/PD and other dynamic systems apps
in mind.

- Bob
